story_fr: Malgre l'absence du Super Bowl, l'EBITDA ajuste de Fox a progresse de 11% a 954 millions de dollars au T3 FY2026, demontrant une forte discipline operationnelle et un levier sur les couts.
story_en: Despite the absence of Super Bowl LIX, Fox's Adjusted EBITDA grew 11% to $954M in Q3 FY2026, demonstrating strong cost discipline and operating leverage.
quote: Adjusted EBITDA was $954 million, an increase of $98 million or 11% from the amount reported in the prior year quarter

story_fr: Tubi, le service de streaming gratuit finance par la publicite de Fox, continue d'afficher une croissance digitale soutenue et s'impose comme relais de croissance face au declin de la TV lineaire.
story_en: Tubi, Fox's free ad-supported streaming service, continues to drive sustained digital growth, emerging as the key secular offset to linear TV decline.
quote: continued digital growth led by the Tubi AVOD service

story_fr: Fox a lance Fox One, son nouveau service de streaming direct aux consommateurs, marquant une entree dans la distribution directe et diversifiant ses canaux de revenus au-dela du cable.
story_en: Fox launched Fox One, its new direct-to-consumer streaming service, marking a significant entry into direct distribution and diversifying revenue beyond traditional cable.
quote: costs associated with the launch of Fox One

story_fr: Les revenus de distribution ont progresse de 3% au T3 FY2026, portes par une hausse de 5% dans le segment Cable, grace aux revalorisations tarifaires contractuelles malgre la baisse du nombre d'abonnes.
story_en: Distribution revenue grew 3% in Q3 FY2026, led by 5% growth in the Cable segment, driven by contractual rate increases that more than offset subscriber declines.
quote: Distribution revenue increased 3%, driven by 5% growth at the Cable Network Programming segment

story_fr: Fox diffusera la Coupe du Monde FIFA 2026 en Amerique du Nord en juin et juillet 2026, un catalyseur publicitaire majeur qui devrait generer un fort pic de revenus publicitaires au T4 FY2026.
story_en: Fox will broadcast the FIFA Men's World Cup 2026 across North America in June-July 2026, a major advertising catalyst expected to drive a significant revenue spike in Q4 FY2026.
quote: we are proud to be bringing the world's biggest sporting event to American homes with the FIFA Men's World Cup hosted here in North America across June and July

story_fr: Fox a annonce un rachat accelere d'actions de 1,5 milliard de dollars et augmente son autorisation de rachat de 5 milliards, signalant une forte confiance de la direction dans la solidite du bilan.
story_en: Fox announced a $1.5 billion Accelerated Share Repurchase and increased its buyback authorization by $5 billion, signaling strong management confidence in the balance sheet.
quote: $1.5 billion Accelerated Share Repurchase Transaction... $5 billion increase to our share repurchase authorization
